# analytics-mcp

Self-hosted MCP + JSON API server for three Google APIs: Analytics Data (GA4),
Search Console and Google Ads (reads plus targeted writes: campaigns, ad groups,
ads, keywords, budgets, conversion actions and account conversion goals).

## Connectors and accounts

| connector | account | example fields |
|---|---|---|
| `googleanalytics4` | GA4 property id | `date`, `source`, `sessions`, `users`, `screen_page_views` |
| `searchconsole` | Search Console property URL | `query`, `page`, `date`, `clicks`, `impressions`, `ctr`, `position` |
| `google_ads` | Google Ads customer id | `campaign_name`, `spend`, `clicks`, `conversions`, `search_term` |
| `google_ads` + `options.keyword_seeds` | customer id | Keyword Planner ideas: volume, competition, top-of-page bids |

Ads fields are flat names mapped to GAQL; a dotted GAQL path (`conversion_action.status`) also
works and is passed through with its resource as the FROM clause.

## HTTP API (dashboards)

POST /query  {connector, account, fields[], date_from, date_to, group_by[], limit}
             -> {status:"done", data:[...], total_rows:N}
POST /action {connector, account, action, params{}}
             actions: pause_campaign, enable_campaign, push_negative_keywords, set_campaign_budget,
                      create_campaign, create_ad_group, mutate, add_keywords, set_keyword_status,
                      remove_keyword, set_ad_group_status, set_ad_status, set_conversion_action

Writes accept `validate_only: true` (Google checks the mutation without applying it) and
`partial_failure: true`; campaigns and ad groups can be paused but not removed.

Both require `Authorization: Bearer *** from the OAuth flow at /authorize.

## MCP tools

ping, auth_status, ga4_report, gsc_query, ads_search, ads_keyword_ideas,
ads_set_campaign_status, ads_push_negative_keywords, ads_mutate, ads_add_keywords,
ads_set_keyword_status, ads_remove_keyword, ads_set_ad_group_status, ads_set_ad_status,
ads_set_campaign_budget, ads_conversion_action_update — every write requires `confirm: true`.

Get started: call `auth_status`; if it reports `authenticated: false`, open
/authorize in a browser and link a Google account that can see the GA4 property,
the Search Console site and the Ads account.
